title: 真实Envoy子集隔离：同时关闭全局与selector兜底，空集不跨租户版本
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)返回深拷贝，只把service cluster的lb_subset_config.fallback_policy及其每个subset_selectors[].fallback_policy设置为NO_FALLBACK。原metadata键tenant/version、三组端点、路由、健康panic阈值0及panic_mode_any=False必须保留。不能只改全局而遗漏selector覆盖，不能放宽为只按tenant选择。实际运行Envoy，指定A/v9等不存在版本、缺键、拼错键及未知租户必须503且任何业务后端零接收；已存在A/v1、A/v2、B/v1仍各自唯一收到请求。再对独立启动的端点快照验证A/v1不健康时只拒绝该子集，以及端点版本从v1变v3后旧选择失败、新选择成功。原公开健康200与未知路由404保持，伪造客户端头不能改变批准路由metadata。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13单worker/静态cluster与三个独立回环HTTP端点，以各后端实际接收计数证明所选身份；真实重现ANY_ENDPOINT跨租户/版本兜底。健康状态及metadata变体通过分别启动的原生实例验收，不冒充在线xDS更新；healthy_panic_threshold=0是原批准条件，不是本题偷偷关闭健康保护。metadata来自可信固定路由，subset不是完整租户鉴权机制，未验证动态身份来源或数据驻留全链路。缺匹配时明确牺牲可用性，不扩大访问范围，不构建镜像。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    result=copy.deepcopy(base)
    subset=result["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]["lb_subset_config"]
    subset["fallback_policy"]="NO_FALLBACK"
    for selector in subset["subset_selectors"]:
        selector["fallback_policy"]="NO_FALLBACK"
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
subset选择依赖请求metadata与端点metadata，匹配不到时可能按配置回退到更大集合，因而“通常路由到专属端点”不是强隔离。应列出匹配键、允许值、缺失字段和fallback策略，确认端点健康变化后仍不会发送到未经授权的服务。验收不存在subset、所有匹配端点不健康、metadata拼写错误和端点更新，检查实际上游身份与拒绝原因。若subset只是性能偏好，可接受明确回退；若承担安全或数据驻留要求，则须失败关闭并有独立权限保护。交付容量与可用性代价，不能把更宽回退当无损恢复。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释过滤链、资源与协议的作用范围
交付专用请求矩阵和实际目标证据
明确版本、资源与失败策略

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json,pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,student
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
def endpoint(port,tenant,version):
 return {"endpoint":{"address":{"socket_address":{"address":"127.0.0.1","port_value":port}}},
  "metadata":{"filter_metadata":{"envoy.lb":{"tenant":tenant,"version":version}}}}
def route(path,metadata):
 return {"match":{"path":path},"route":{"cluster":"service","metadata_match":{"filter_metadata":{"envoy.lb":metadata}}}}
with Upstream() as a1,Upstream() as a2,Upstream() as b1:
 peers={"A-v1":a1,"A-v2":a2,"B-v1":b1}
 base=bootstrap(a1.port);cluster=base["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]
 cluster["load_assignment"]["endpoints"][0]["lb_endpoints"]=[endpoint(a1.port,"A","v1"),endpoint(a2.port,"A","v2"),endpoint(b1.port,"B","v1")]
 cluster["lb_subset_config"]={"fallback_policy":"ANY_ENDPOINT","panic_mode_any":False,
  "subset_selectors":[{"keys":["tenant","version"],"fallback_policy":"ANY_ENDPOINT"}]}
 cluster["common_lb_config"]={"healthy_panic_threshold":{"value":0}}
 routes=[route("/A/v1",{"tenant":"A","version":"v1"}),route("/A/v2",{"tenant":"A","version":"v2"}),
  route("/B/v1",{"tenant":"B","version":"v1"}),route("/A/v9",{"tenant":"A","version":"v9"}),
  route("/B/v9",{"tenant":"B","version":"v9"}),route("/C/v1",{"tenant":"C","version":"v1"}),
  route("/missing-key",{"tenant":"A"}),route("/typo",{"tenant":"A","versoin":"v1"}),
  route("/A/v3",{"tenant":"A","version":"v3"}),
  {"match":{"path":"/health"},"direct_response":{"status":200,"body":{"inline_string":"ready"}}},
  {"match":{"prefix":"/"},"direct_response":{"status":404}}]
 hcm(base)["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"]=routes
 def counts():return {name:len(peer.requests) for name,peer in peers.items()}
 observations=[]
 def verify(server,path,expected=None,headers=None):
  before=counts();status,body,_=server.request(path,headers=headers);after=counts()
  touched=[name for name in peers if after[name]>before[name]]
  if expected is None:assert status==503 and not touched,("empty or invalid subset leaked",path,status,touched)
  else:assert status==200 and touched==[expected] and after[expected]==before[expected]+1,(path,status,touched)
  observations.append(dict(path=path,status=status,upstreams=touched))
 with Envoy(base) as old:
  touched=set()
  for _ in range(9):
   before=counts();assert old.request("/A/v9")[0]==200
   touched.update(name for name,value in counts().items() if value>before[name])
  assert "B-v1" in touched and "A-v1" in touched,"wider fallback not actually reproduced"
 print("NATIVE_SUBSET_MISSING_VERSION_BASELINE_ACTUALLY_REACHES_OTHER_TENANT_AND_VERSION",flush=True)
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
 with Envoy(fixed) as server:
  for path,name in [("/A/v1","A-v1"),("/A/v2","A-v2"),("/B/v1","B-v1")]:verify(server,path,name)
  for path in ["/A/v9","/B/v9","/C/v1","/missing-key","/typo","/A/v3"]:verify(server,path)
  verify(server,"/A/v1","A-v1",{"x-tenant":"B","x-version":"v9"})
  before_count=counts();assert server.request("/health")[:2]==(200,b"ready") and server.request("/unknown")[0]==404 and counts()==before_count
 expected=copy.deepcopy(base);subset=expected["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]["lb_subset_config"]
 subset["fallback_policy"]="NO_FALLBACK";subset["subset_selectors"][0]["fallback_policy"]="NO_FALLBACK"
 assert fixed==expected,"approved change is limited to both fallback scopes"
 # Native static endpoint-state variants use independent instances, not a claim of live xDS delivery.
 unhealthy=copy.deepcopy(fixed)
 unhealthy["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]["load_assignment"]["endpoints"][0]["lb_endpoints"][0]["health_status"]="UNHEALTHY"
 with Envoy(unhealthy) as server:
  verify(server,"/A/v1");verify(server,"/A/v2","A-v2");verify(server,"/B/v1","B-v1")
 changed=copy.deepcopy(fixed)
 changed["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]["load_assignment"]["endpoints"][0]["lb_endpoints"][0]["metadata"]["filter_metadata"]["envoy.lb"]["version"]="v3"
 with Envoy(changed) as server:
  verify(server,"/A/v1");verify(server,"/A/v3","A-v1");verify(server,"/B/v1","B-v1")
 print("NATIVE_SUBSET_SELECTOR_AND_TOPLEVEL_NO_FALLBACK_EMPTY_KEYS_UNHEALTHY_AND_METADATA_UPDATE "+json.dumps(observations),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
